name: web-pastel-lilac-care-app-scroll-with-blurred-tags-and-dashed-route
title: Lilac scroll with italic sans lines, a dashed winding route, blurred symptom tags, small photo cards and a billboard-style screen
whatItIs: A very pale lilac tall page with a winding dashed line linking centred italic lines ('Helping Seniors Living Independently', 'With or Without Memory Challenges'), blurred floating tags (Overwhelming, Anxious), small tilted photo cards of seniors, a wide screen showing a grandfather laughing with a child and a purple phones panel, and a location-tracker pin at the end.
whatItMeans: Gentle and reassuring; the dashed route and blur guide the eye softly through a story.
techniques: Link sections with a dashed winding line.
Blur floating tags in the periphery.

vocabulary.definition: A dotted line winding through a page.
A softly out-of-focus label as decoration.
A small rotated photo with a white border.
A location pin closing a route.
